newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan-Mar industry output seen up 1.9% qtr/qtr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan-Mar industry output seen up 1.9% qtr/qtr.

text.p: Japan's industrial output is seen rising a revised 1.9 percent in the January-March period from the previous quarter and rising a revised 6.5 percent from the same period last year, a trade ministry official said on Tuesday.
This compares with the previous forecast for the January-March period of a 2.1 percent quarter-on-quarter rise and a 6.7 percent year-on-year increase.
A ministry official said the figures showed that Japan's industrial output continues to be on a rising trend.
The official said a 3.7 percent fall in the capacity utilisation rate in February from a month earlier would not affect the ministry's overall view that there was a rising trend in industrial output.
He also said inventory levels were improving. Inventories fell 0.7 percent in February from a month earlier.
